title: 咘咘的马迭尔冰棍和金色老江桥
title_en: Bubu’s Favorite Ice Cream and the Golden Old River Bridge

pages.text: 封面：咘咘拿着马迭尔冰棍，在金色夕阳中的老江桥上开心跑；爸爸妈妈、爷爷奶奶、外公外婆在旁边笑着陪她，鸥鸟飞过松花江。
pages.text_en: Cover: Bubu happily runs on the old river bridge in golden sunset light, holding a Madieer ice cream bar. Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma smile alongside her while gulls fly over the Songhua River.

pages.text: 今天，咘咘和全家来到热热闹闹的中央大街。
pages.text_en: Today, Bubu and her whole family come to lively Central Street.

pages.text: 街上有漂亮的老房子，还有好多好多好吃的香味。
pages.text_en: The street has beautiful old buildings and so many delicious smells.

pages.text: 爸爸停在一个小店前：“咘咘，今天有你最喜欢的马迭尔冰棍。”
pages.text_en: Dad stops in front of a little shop. “Bubu, today they have your favorite Madieer ice cream bar.”

pages.text: 咘咘接过冰棍，开心得眼睛弯成了小月亮。
pages.text_en: Bubu takes the ice cream bar, and her happy eyes curve like little moons.

pages.text: 她舔一小口——凉凉的、甜甜的，真好吃！
pages.text_en: She licks a little bite—cool, sweet, and so delicious!

pages.text: 咘咘又舔一小口，爸爸妈妈、爷爷奶奶、外公外婆都笑了。
pages.text_en: Bubu takes another little lick, and Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma all smile.

pages.text: 吃完最喜欢的冰棍，大家慢慢走向宽宽的松花江。
pages.text_en: After finishing her favorite ice cream bar, everyone slowly walks toward the broad Songhua River.

pages.text: 天空飞来好多白白的鸥鸟，在江面上张开翅膀转呀转。
pages.text_en: Many white gulls fly into the sky, spreading their wings and circling over the river.

pages.text: 咘咘安静地看着鸥鸟，不追它们，也不喂它们零食。
pages.text_en: Bubu watches the gulls quietly. She does not chase them or feed them snacks.

pages.text: 前面是一座长长的老桥——哈尔滨铁路桥，也叫老江桥。
pages.text_en: Ahead is a long old bridge—the Harbin Railway Bridge, also called the Old River Bridge.

pages.text: 爸爸说：“它以前通火车，现在是一座能散步看风景的观光桥。”
pages.text_en: Dad says, “It used to carry trains. Now it is a sightseeing bridge where people can walk and enjoy the view.”

pages.text: 桥上有旧旧的铁轨和高高的钢梁，脚下是宽宽的松花江。
pages.text_en: On the bridge are old rails and high steel beams, with the wide Songhua River below.

pages.text: 咘咘一下子跑起来！她在老江桥上跑呀跑，开心得像一只小白兔。
pages.text_en: Bubu suddenly starts running! She runs and runs across the Old River Bridge, happy like a little white rabbit.

pages.text: 爸爸妈妈、爷爷奶奶、外公外婆在旁边跟着她，笑着提醒：“慢一点，注意脚下。”
pages.text_en: Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Maternal Grandpa, and Maternal Grandma follow beside her, smiling as they remind her, “Slow down and watch your step.”

pages.text: 太阳一点一点落下去，天空和松花江都变成金色。
pages.text_en: The sun slowly goes down, turning both the sky and the Songhua River golden.

pages.text: 咘咘停下来，靠在爸爸妈妈身边看夕阳：“今天有我最喜欢的冰棍，还有最漂亮的夕阳！”
pages.text_en: Bubu stops and leans against Dad and Mom to watch the sunset. “Today had my favorite ice cream bar and the most beautiful sunset!”

pages.text: 金色的老江桥、飞翔的鸥鸟和一家人的笑声，陪咘咘一起回到酒店。
pages.text_en: The golden Old River Bridge, flying gulls, and the family’s laughter go with Bubu back to the hotel.
